summary: Independent audit of V2-06 phase 2 (backend operational adapters + remaining Research Analytics Plane features). Trusted verification exit code is 0 (confirmed from reports/audits/TRUSTED_33402384188.md). The candidate working tree is identical to the pristine accepted tree (excluding reports/.opencode), confirming this is a re-audit of the already-accepted phase 2 content. All 577 tests pass across 16 suites, TypeScript typecheck clean. Backend operational adapters (auth, sync, invitations, billing, permissions, SecureStorage, push, calendar) are honest local adapters behind proper ports with no fake OAuth/payment/push/calendar/sync. Research Analytics Plane is complete: query budget/rate limit, differential privacy (Laplace and Gaussian with correct math), consent/purpose/jurisdiction policy, buyer contracts always prohibiting re-identification/redistribution, and audit/export log with provenance. Strict Operational Store / Research Analytics Store separation maintained; analytics store types contain zero operational IDs, free text, or join keys; analytics is disableable without breaking the product. No must-fix finding remains.
